means: Constructed replays, one per drawn node of shiwehi.com's 迷走砲 route page: our own piece queue and key inputs, run from an empty board through the vendored Triangle engine, ending on the page's drawn board. Not a game anyone played and not corpus data.
not_eligible_because: not a game anyone played; not corpus data
one engine, no second implementation of the boards

caveat.order: Where the page does not fix the piece order, the order here is ours: the early piece first, the first piece of each of the page's before-pairs next, then IOTSZJL, the T into a drawn U last where the drawing shows U empty. order_reading records it per bag.
caveat.hold: Only bag1.z_hold uses hold: its Z is held when it arrives, just before J. No other demo holds.
caveat.early: The page gives no threshold for "early"; the demo puts the early piece first in its bag.
caveat.colour_readings: Two Perfect Clear drawings colour one piece in another piece's colour; the demo builds the piece the cells have to be (piece_readings).
caveat.spin: Every T-spin kind and line count is the engine's verdict on the replayed inputs.
